blockbuilder.visual_critic_note: Consistent single-hue palette and clever color-in-HCL-space encoding show design intent, but the 16px title reads as body text, everything is cramped at 6px panel gaps, and 9px network labels are borderline illegible — functional and coherent but not deliberately designed.
blockbuilder.encoding_integrity_note: Zero baseline on histogram bars (domain [0, maxCount]), scaleSqrt for both network and color circle sizes, all scale domains derived from data via d3.extent/d3.max — no encoding violations found across all three chart panels.
blockbuilder.stress_test_note: RAF dirty-flag pattern correctly coalesces all brush/pointer events; no transitions in interactive paths eliminate mid-flight snap risk; pointer events unify touch/mouse; only gap is scales captured in static closures with no resize handler, leaving them stale after window resize.
blockbuilder.cognitive_load_note: 4-panel crossfilter with pre-computed force layout and dirty-flag RAF batching keeps cognitive load well-managed; the color scatter is inherently busy but intentionally so (each dot is the data), while the monochromatic blue network and clean timeline stay within working memory limits across all 4 linked filter dimensions.
